about: Video 006 Hold On To This: the shot list (a new shot every 2-4 s, each matching its caption), shared by the picture (engine/src/scenes/hold/) and the sound (engine/tools/mix_hold.py). world = the nature set's world (sets/nature.ts).

shots.why: dawn over the misty pine forest: a drone glides down to him walking the path into the light
a mushaf held gently against his chest, light falling on it
Look, young man: on a rock above the clouds at sunrise, the camera rises with him
honour and dignity: a slow orbit, chest up, the wind
you lose your father: the empty chair on the porch above the canyon, the kufi on it; his hand reaches to it; the river flows on
you lose your mother: a shawl on the sill, tea still steaming, light through the curtains
you lose your wealth: gold coins slip from his hand into a clear stream and wash away
you lose your wife and children: the home at dusk, small shoes by the door, the swing moving, empty
you lose your limbs: in a wheelchair by a big window over a green valley, sunlight on him; the camera circles
calm: past him, through the window, over the valley
but lose this religion: the light drains, the masjid lantern on the lake goes out, fog swallows the lake
I know a young man: a sleek car glides through a bamboo grove at night
three bank cards: cards on the glass table, shining
everything comes to him: the penthouse over the lavender-lit city, shopping bags
bored and fed up: alone on a huge sofa, phone to his ear, motionless, the city glittering
why are you bored?: a slow push into the setting sun over the wheat; the question held in silence
13:28 Those who have believed: dawn; he puts the phone down
and whose hearts are assured: wudu at a stream, water over his hands
by the remembrance of Allah: he walks the dock toward the small masjid glowing by the lake as the fog lifts
Unquestionably...: the Traveller and he pray side by side
hearts are assured: birds take off over the water
13:29 Those who believed and did righteous deeds: a drone glides over lavender at golden hour
the wheat in the rising sun
a good state is theirs: the two walk home together on the path, the sunrise ahead
and a good return: a slow crane up into the sky
